name: Moswen Ağaoğlu-Delacroix
location: Irkalla, sub-level fungal warrens beneath Deepwell Station
description:
Moswen is a broad-shouldered woman with skin the color of dark river clay, her face mapped by deep laugh lines and a permanent stain of blue-black around her fingernails from decades of handling bioluminescent mycelium. Her geneware is old and half-degraded — color-shifting hair that now only cycles between a dim amber and a washed-out grey depending on her mood, installed in her thirties when she still had money for upkeep. She wears a patchwork coat of heat-cured mushroom leather, stitched with dozens of pockets holding spore vials, dried caps, and small fungal compresses. She smells faintly of earth, wet stone, and something fermented.

Moswen came down in 2178 after her Axiom maintenance contract evaporated and she couldn't surface her debt. She built her farm over seven years — tiered shelves of inoculated substrate carved from old ferrogate sleeper beams, lit by her own bioluminescent cultures. She knows forty-three species by taste and can diagnose infections, parse poisons, and brew painkillers that rival surface pharmacy stock for a fraction of the cost. She is neither warm nor cold — she is practical, like the organisms she cultivates, and she extends exactly as much care as the situation requires.

core_fears: being forced back to the surface where her debt still exists
her farm being destroyed — it is the only thing she built herself
core_desires: stability and sufficiency — not wealth, just enough
to be genuinely useful to people who have no one else
coping_mechanisms: cataloguing and naming — gives her a sense of control over her environment
blind_spots: underestimates how dependent the surrounding community has become on her, and thus underestimates her own leverage and her own danger
psychology.secret: She maintains a hidden culture of a rare paralytic fungus she developed herself — not to sell, but as a last resort if Axiom debt collectors ever come underground. She has never told anyone it exists.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: plain, precise, often uses botanical or mycological terminology without explanation — she forgets others don't share her frame of reference
speech_patterns.cadence: slow and even, like someone who has learned not to waste breath in thin air
example_lines: 'The blue ones are analgesic. The grey ones will drop your blood pressure to nothing. I assume you want the blue ones.'
'Surface debt doesn't grow down here. Neither does surface law. That's the deal — you accept both sides of it or you go back up.'

story_hooks: A new fungal blight is spreading through her farm — she needs someone to trace it to its source before it wipes out the only pharmacy for eight tunnel-kilometers
An Axiom bioprospecting team has somehow learned about her paralytic culture and sent someone down to negotiate — or take it
narrative_function: Quest giver, information source, supplier of consumables, moral anchor for underworld storylines — she has seen everything and judges nothing but stupidity
augmentations: degraded color-shift geneware (hair), subdermal warming mesh (keeps core temp stable in cold tunnels, bought secondhand), no other chrome
daily_life: Spends mornings checking mycelium growth, harvesting ripe caps, and processing drying racks; afternoons she receives visitors — the sick, the desperate, tunnel guides stocking medkits — and barters for food, tools, or information.
affiliation: independent, loose ties to Bore Rat community Deepwell Station cell

decision_rules: barter fair, never credit — generosity is fine but debt rots relationships
do not involve yourself in tunnel politics unless your farm is directly threatened
escalation_ladder: deployment of fungal deterrents (spore clouds, contact irritants)
the paralytic culture as absolute last resort

interpersonal_modes.strangers: assesses immediately what they need and whether she can provide it — transactional but not unkind
interpersonal_modes.friends: quietly attentive, remembers small details, will go significantly out of her way without saying so

stress_responses.low: becomes more methodical, cleans and reorganizes shelves
stress_responses.medium: stops talking, communicates in short declarative statements only
stress_responses.high: extremely calm in a way that frightens people who know her well

contradictions: preaches self-sufficiency but maintains quiet, unacknowledged care networks for the most vulnerable tunnel dwellers
habits: tastes every new fungal batch before selling it
keeps a worn paper journal of species notes even though she has a data-chip
breaking_points: harm to a child in her care

carried_weapons: Street Custom 'Tooth Fairy' Pneumatic Bolt Pistol
